class BoardMPC:
    def __init__(self,model,horizon=25):
        self.A=np.array(model['A']);self.B=np.array(model['B']);self.c=np.array(model['c']);self.xr=np.array(model['xref']);self.ur=np.array(model['uref']);self.N=horizon
        self.S=np.zeros((horizon*12,horizon*4));self.T=np.zeros((horizon*12,12));self.d=np.zeros(horizon*12)
        power=np.eye(12);bias=np.zeros(12)
        for i in range(horizon):
            power=self.A@power;bias=self.A@bias+self.c
            self.T[i*12:(i+1)*12]=power;self.d[i*12:(i+1)*12]=bias
            for j in range(i+1):self.S[i*12:(i+1)*12,j*4:(j+1)*4]=np.linalg.matrix_power(self.A,i-j)@self.B
        self.weights=np.tile([200,2000,1,1,1,2,2,10,.05,.05,.05,.05],horizon)
        self.R=np.tile([5,5,5,15],horizon)
        self.C=self.S[np.arange(horizon)*12+1];self.D=self.S[np.arange(horizon)*12]
        self.H=self.S.T@(self.weights[:,None]*self.S)+np.diag(self.R)
        self.bounds=[(-1.5,.5),(.6,1.4),(-.87,.52),(-1.3,.7)]*horizon
    def solve(self,x,warm=None):
        from scipy.optimize import minimize
        base=self.T@x+self.d
        err=base-np.tile(self.xr,self.N)
        g=self.S.T@(self.weights*err)-self.R*np.tile(self.ur,self.N)
        bp=base[np.arange(self.N)*12+1];tp=base[np.arange(self.N)*12]
        def objective(u):
            ph=self.C@u+bp;th=self.D@u+tp
            pv=np.maximum(abs(ph)-.32,0)*np.sign(ph);tv=np.maximum(abs(th)-.4,0)*np.sign(th)
            val=.5*u@self.H@u+g@u+5000*(pv@pv)+1500*(tv@tv)
            grad=self.H@u+g+10000*self.C.T@pv+3000*self.D.T@tv
            return val,grad
        if warm is None:u0=np.tile(self.ur,self.N)
        else:u0=np.r_[warm[4:],warm[-4:]]
        result=minimize(objective,u0,jac=True,bounds=self.bounds,method='L-BFGS-B',options={'maxiter':150,'ftol':1e-8,'gtol':1e-5})
